items.title: Another day of survival for a family in Ukraine
items.excerpt: On the outskirts of Kyiv, one family prepares for the fifth winter of war against Russia -- stockpiling food and fuel and trying to maintain as much a sense of normalcy as possible.

items.title: Trump touts meeting with Xi and Putin but offers little results
items.excerpt: At a White House press conference Friday, Trump offered little in actual results of the meetings, beyond a joint statement on unity over some issues.

items.title: Dems aim to block Iran war funding. And, Army delays lead azide detonation in Iowa
items.excerpt: Congress needs to pass a funding measure to avoid a shutdown next month, providing Dems an opportunity to leverage power. And, the Army says waiting to detonate lead azide could become dangerous.

items.title: GOP Sen. Johnson rejects tying government funding to an end to the Iran war
items.excerpt: "We're not going to shut down the war," Sen. Ron Johnson said as Republicans and Democrats struggle to reach a government funding deal.

items.title: The U.K. and EU hold a rare summit to strengthen ties
items.excerpt: A decade after the people of Britain voted to leave the European Union, top EU officials are meeting with Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Friday, looking to mend more fences.

items.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
items.excerpt: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.

items.title: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
items.excerpt: Despite growing concern over a possible AI bubble, Anthropic had a record-breaking initial public offering. And, Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black Speaker of the House.

items.title: Top House Democrat questions what Trump accomplished in Xi-Putin summit
items.excerpt: Rep. Gregory Meeks raises concerns about U.S. alliances after Trump's summit with Xi and Putin. He also discusses Chinese espionage amid the Nvidia scandal.

items.title: Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz escalate
items.excerpt: Iran takes the offensive with attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and airstrikes on several countries around the Persian Gulf.

items.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet as global alliances hang in the balance
items.excerpt: President Trump, China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin have gathered in Shenzhen, China, for a historic trilateral meeting, with Ukraine, Iran and nuclear disarmament on the agenda.
